reason: My team is 15 to 50 people and already knows Bitrix24, even if it is heavy. Moving everyone to a CRM with zero references is a big risk for me, and the plan I would need is 199 a month.
objection: No customers to show, so I would be the guinea pig. If it breaks, my sales team loses deals and I answer for it. Also I only need contacts and deals, and 199 for finance and helpdesk I will not use is a lot.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three real Uzbek companies of my size using it who I can call, plus a plan with just contacts, deals and Telegram for 15+ users at a lower price.
